title: EXPERIMENTAL VALIDATION OF THE METHODOLOGY FOR DIFFERENTIATED INSTRUCTION ORGANISATION IN LMS MOODLE
reason: Ukrainian-language EG/CG experiment: entry and final test scores compared by Mann-Whitney and Wilcoxon, plus a satisfaction survey; learning styles diagnosed by questionnaire only for grouping; no per-student Moodle activity measure is analysed.

extraction.n_quote: До дослідження залучено 54 студенти, поділені на контрольну й експериментальну групи.
extraction.population: undergraduate students of an IT-infrastructure course, 1 university (Borys Grinchenko Kyiv Metropolitan University)
extraction.lms_indicators: none analysed (Moodle progress analytics described as a feature only)
extraction.notes: Ukrainian full text (eligible language). Learning styles, interests and motivation captured by a 30-item questionnaire and used to differentiate tasks, not related to outcomes.
